scripts.all: npm run db && sleep 2 && npx concurrently -n api,web,judge -c blue,green,yellow "npm run api:dev" "npm run web:dev" "npm run judge:dev"
scripts.build: cd api && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run db && sleep 2 && npx concurrently -n api,web,judge -c blue,green,yellow "cd api && npm start" "cd web && npm start" "npm run judge:dev"
scripts.setup: cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../judge-core && mvn package -q -DskipTests
